title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
description: Privacy and cookie policy of Hotel Drei Könige Chur: what data we process, why, who receives it and what rights you have.
privacyPolicyHtml:
Privacy Policy

We take the protection of your personal data seriously. This policy explains, briefly and plainly, what data we process when you use this website, contact us or make a booking. It follows the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revFADP) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

1. Controller

Hotel Drei Könige
Reichsgasse 18
7000 Chur
Switzerland
info@dreikoenige.ch

2. Visiting the website

Our website is hosted by Netlify, Inc. (USA). Each visit records technically necessary data in server log files: IP address, date and time, page requested, referrer, browser and operating system. We need this data to deliver the website, keep it secure and fix problems (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Only with your consent do we also use Google Analytics (section 4).

3. Content from third parties

To display the website, some content is loaded directly from external servers. For technical reasons, your IP address is sent to the provider concerned:

  • Google Fonts (Google LLC, USA / Google Ireland Ltd.): typefaces, on every page.
  • OpenStreetMap (OpenStreetMap Foundation, United Kingdom): embedded map in the “Practical Matters” section.
  • Unsplash (Unsplash Inc., USA): some images on the home page.
  • Netlify Identity (Netlify, Inc., USA): a small script for our editors to sign in to the content management system; it does nothing for visitors.

The purpose is to display the website consistently and correctly (legitimate interest).

4. Web analytics with Google Analytics

Only if you click “Accept” in the cookie banner do we use Google Analytics 4, a service of Google Ireland Limited (Ireland) and Google LLC (USA). It gives us statistics on how our website is used (e.g. pages viewed, time spent, country or region, device and browser) so that we can improve it. Google Analytics 4 does not store IP addresses; Google signals and advertising features are switched off. Without your consent, Google Analytics is not loaded and no data is sent to Google.

The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). Google may transfer data to the USA; Google LLC is certified under the EU-U.S. and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. You can withdraw your consent at any time via “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page. For more information, see Google’s privacy policy.

5. Contacting us by email

If you write to info@dreikoenige.ch, we process your details (e.g. name, email address, content of your message) to answer your request and, where relevant, to prepare your stay.

6. Online booking via SimpleBooking

Online bookings are made exclusively through the SimpleBooking booking engine (QNT S.r.l., Florence, Italy). The data you enter there (e.g. name, contact details, dates of stay, payment information) is processed by SimpleBooking and passed on to us so that we can handle your booking and meet our legal obligations (performance of a contract, Art. 6(1)(b) and (c) GDPR). The booking engine is covered by SimpleBooking’s privacy policy.

7. Recipients and transfers abroad

We do not sell personal data. The only recipients are the service providers named above: Netlify (hosting), SimpleBooking (bookings) Google (fonts and, only with your consent, web analytics) and OpenStreetMap and Unsplash (website content). Some of them are based in the USA or the United Kingdom. Data is only transferred to countries without an adequate level of data protection with appropriate safeguards, such as the Swiss-U.S. or EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses. Authorities only receive data where the law requires it.

8. Retention

We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purpose concerned or as required by statutory retention obligations (e.g. accounting records for up to 10 years). Server log files are kept by our host for a short period only. Google Analytics data is deleted automatically after 14 months.

9. Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict processing, to object, to data portability and to withdraw any consent you have given, with effect for the future. Please send your request to info@dreikoenige.ch. You may also lodge a complaint with the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC) or with a data protection supervisory authority in the EU.

10. Changes

We will update this policy if our website or the law changes. The version published here applies.
cookiePolicyHtml:
Cookies

Cookies and similar technologies (such as your browser’s local storage) store small pieces of data on your device. We use:

  • dk-consent (local storage, our website): stores your choice in the cookie banner (accepted or rejected) and the date. Strictly necessary and never sent anywhere; we ask again after 12 months.
  • _ga and _ga_TZVSDCQT33 (Google Analytics cookies): tell visits and sessions apart for the statistics. Only with your consent; stored for up to 2 years.

You can change your choice at any time via “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page. If you withdraw your consent, Google Analytics is stopped and the Google Analytics cookies are deleted from your browser.

Based on our check, the third-party providers named above (Google Fonts, OpenStreetMap, Unsplash) do not set cookies when their content loads, but they do receive your IP address. Netlify Identity stores a sign-in cookie or browser storage entry only when members of our editorial team sign in to the content management system.

The SimpleBooking booking engine runs on its own website and may use its own cookies there. For details, see SimpleBooking’s privacy policy.

You can block or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings.
